 By @GerardCrispin via LowKickMMA.com, 23h ago Alexander Volkanovski has shared his pick for the upcoming UFC 334 co-main event between Kayla Harrison and Amanda Nunes. The fight, set to take place at Madison Square Garden, marks the returning Nunes take on Harrison in her first defense of the UFC Women’s Bantamweight title. With the fight just a couple of days away, UFC‘s official Instagram handle shared a post showing several notable UFC fighters’ predictions for the co-main event. And among those were Volkanovski’s.
